Enable Spicy Dialogue.Description: Enables somewhat spicier dialogue from relevant spouses. Will not do anything without corresponding enabled options below.

MoreWizard.Description: If enabled and Wizard is selected at the Winter Star with Unique Winter Star installed, gives Magnus unique dating and married variants for when he is married to the farmer (Magnus does not have a spicy variant). Disable to remove these dialogue changes and only get Unique Winter Star's (platonic) variant. (Without Unique Winter Star, this setting will do nothing.)

CustomGifts.Description: Allows a custom gift list to be used for each NPC, including an 'ultimate gift' that can be obtained upon reaching high hearts with an NPC. This will increase the variety of gifts given at the Winter Star, but may also prevent the Tea Set from being gifted by certain characters.

Sophia.Description: Determines if Sophia's dialogue changes are enabled and/or if she's in the gift pool at the Winter Star. If the Spicy Dialogue toggle is enabled and Sophia is set to 'spicy dialogue enabled', allow Sophia to say a slightly spicier end dialogue when married to the player.

Claire.Description: Determines if Claire's dialogue changes are enabled and/or if she's in the gift pool at the Winter Star. If the Spicy Dialogue toggle is enabled and Claire is set to 'spicy dialogue enabled', allow Claire to say a slightly spicier end dialogue when married to the player.

Victor.Description: Determines if Victor's dialogue changes are enabled and/or if she's in the gift pool at the Winter Star. If the Spicy Dialogue toggle is enabled and Victor is set to 'spicy dialogue enabled', allow Victor to say a slightly spicier end dialogue when married to the player.

Olivia.Description: Determines if Olivia's dialogue changes are enabled and/or if she's in the gift pool at the Winter Star. If the Spicy Dialogue toggle is enabled and Olivia is set to 'spicy dialogue enabled', allow Olivia to say a slightly spicier end dialogue when married to the player.

Scarlett.Description: Determines if Scarlett is a gifter at the Winter Star and if she uses the unique lines provided by this mod. For immersion, with 1.15 she defaults to only joining the gift pool if married to the player.

Lance.AllowValues: off, disabled, marriageonly, marriagespice, earlyadd, dialogueearly, dialoguespice
Lance.Description: Determines if Lance shows up at the Winter Star and whether his lines are edited. In regular SVE, Lance will attend the Winter Star only when married, so the options reflect this behavior and potential alterations.

Andy.Description: Determines if Andy is a gifter at the Winter Star and if he uses the unique lines provided by this mod.

Susan.Description: Determines if Susan is a gifter at the Winter Star and if she uses the unique lines provided by this mod.

Marlon.Description: Determines if Marlon is a gifter at the Winter Star and if he uses the unique lines provided by this mod.

Martin.Description: Allows Martin to attend the Winter Star, with festival dialogue to match.

Morgan.Description: Allows Morgan become a Winter Star gifter once they become social.

Gunther.Description: Allows Gunther to become a Winter Star gifter once he becomes social.
